sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2018 McLaren 720S Coupe Luxury, finished in Ceramic Grey with a tan interior. The odometer on this McLaren currently displays approximately 24,500 miles. The attached Carfax history report indicates no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this McLaren’s past. It also shows registrations in Western states since new. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, this 720S cost $346,955 new. A partial list of notable factory equipment includes the Luxury, Stealth, and Carbon Fiber Exterior Upgrade 1 packs, vehicle lift, and leather upholstery. Notable modifications reported by the seller include 20-inch front and 21-inch rear Vossen wheels, a Weistec Engineering turbo enhancement, a Mega3 Stage 1+ ECU tune, a Ryft exhaust system, and a carbon fiber chin spoiler. McLaren released the 720S for 2017 as the successor to the 650S, offering staggering performance that was more in line with million-dollar hypercars than similarly priced rivals. It features a highly-advanced active suspension system with accelerometers and pressure sensors – but no sway bars – and a massively powerful twin-turbo V8 that allows it to accelerate from 0-124 mph in just 7.8 seconds. Power comes from an M840T 4.0-liter twin-turbo V8, rated at 710 horsepower and 568 lb-ft of torque in stock form. According to the dyno graph pictured in the gallery, this 720S produces 859 wheel horsepower following its modifications, and the seller reports that it produces 988 horsepower at the crank. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission.
